scope: Complete RQ1 from C1 test generation through later-checkpoint regression adjudication; excludes RQ2 and RQ3

cohort.generator_input: Sanitized source-checkpoint specification, workspace, and complete legal base_tests only

mutant_hint_selection.operator_field_policy: Use the raw mutmut operator when present. If null, infer a conservative operator/edit kind from the old/new AST in the diff and mark it as inferred; never represent an inferred label as mutmut-provided.
mutant_hint_selection.representative_rule: Choose the lexicographically smallest stable mutant ID in each family.
mutant_hint_selection.selection_rule: Sort family representatives within each (source_file, operator_or_inferred_ast_kind) stratum by mutant ID; take one per stratum in sorted round-robin order until the cap is reached.

triage.malformed_or_unavailable_result: Mark selected families deferred; do not silently pass them to Guided generation.

generation.candidate_unit: One candidate file with exactly one top-level pytest test function.
generation.retry_policy: Up to two retries only when the process fails before a structured response is captured; a completed response, including an empty or invalid response, is never regenerated.
generation.token_usage_policy: Record reported input/output tokens. Codex CLI does not enforce a hard output-token ceiling; token targets are requested limits, not guaranteed equality of total inference cost.
generation.vanilla_input: Shared C1 specification, workspace, complete legal base_tests, and shared gap brief.
generation.guided_additional_input: At most 16 preselected, C1-only eligible survivor-family IDs, locations, and diffs.

candidate_review.retry_policy: No retry after a response; failed or malformed review means candidates remain unretained.
candidate_review.uncertain_verdict: Reject from the retained suite; no human review is budgeted.

source_checkpoint_validation.baseline_failures: Reuse the hash-matched 36-task C1 baseline audit; generated candidates may not add a new stable failure.
source_checkpoint_validation.rule: A generated candidate is retained only if it collects, is judged specification-correct, passes as an individual test in all three runs, and introduces no new stable failure relative to the hash-matched C1 baseline audit; pre-existing baseline failures do not invalidate an otherwise passing candidate. A Guided candidate must additionally fail as an assertion on its named target mutant in all three fresh runs.

later_checkpoint_evaluation.candidate_eligibility: The exact test ID passed in the source C1 audit and fails in a complete target run.
later_checkpoint_evaluation.timeout_or_setup_error: Infrastructure/inconclusive; never count as a regression without a reproducible application assertion failure.
later_checkpoint_evaluation.candidate_reproduction_budget_formula: Three targeted runs for each distinct eligible test failure observed in an initial later-checkpoint run; denote the number of observations by O, so at most 3*O targeted runs.
later_checkpoint_evaluation.identical_suite_hashes: May share one execution per task/target and are attributed to each matching method.

regression_adjudication.judge_call_budget_formula: 2*N, where N is the number of stable candidate observations admitted to adjudication; N is frozen from the evaluation output before judge calls.
regression_adjudication.judge_input: Source and target specifications, frozen test, source-to-target workspace diff, checkpoint evidence, failure trace, and three reproduction summaries. No hidden/future tests or method label.

analysis.primary_outcome: Unique LLM-confirmed candidate regression events detected by each method.
analysis.event_deduplication: Count the same underlying task/behavior/code-change event once across tests, methods, and later checkpoints; anchor it to the earliest failing target checkpoint.
analysis.uncertainty: 10,000-resample task-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence intervals for paired count differences; paired permutation tests with Holm correction across the two primary contrasts.
analysis.denominator: Deduplicated union of candidate events exposed by at least one frozen suite and confirmed by adjudication.

fairness_statement: Vanilla and Mutation-Guided have identical model, reasoning setting, call cap, requested output-token cap, candidate cap, retry rule, correctness-review budget, and source validation. Guided receives mutation hints as the treatment; its extra triage cost and larger actual input-token usage are reported separately. Do not claim equal total token expenditure unless service usage confirms it.

execution_gates.before_formal_generation: Run manifests must record this budget file's SHA-256; the runner must enforce the survivor-family hint cap, triage-call limit, generation/candidate caps, candidate review rule, and C1 validation repetitions. Verify current C1 package and legal-input hashes before generating.
execution_gates.before_later_checkpoint_evaluation: After generation, all 36 tasks must have Original, Vanilla, and Mutation-Guided C1 suites or explicit empty-suite records. Audit package/base/suite/budget hashes, input isolation, and C1 stability. The evaluator must enforce the one-infrastructure-retry limit before it reads later checkpoint packages.
